name: Forsaken Monument
oracle_text:
Colorless creatures you control get +2/+2.
Whenever you tap a permanent for {C}, add an additional {C}.
Whenever you cast a colorless spell, you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you tap a permanent for {C}, add an additional {C}.
Whenever you cast a colorless spell, you gain 2 life.

needs.what: an add_mana_on_tap condition on the mana the tapped permanent PRODUCED rather than on what the permanent is: "whenever you tap a permanent for {C}" fires when any permanent's {T} mana ability makes {C} (Sol Ring, Wastes, Eldrazi Temple), for any permanent type, and adds {C}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_mana_on_tap's tapped_permanent takes only types, subtypes, supertypes and attached (player_statics.mana_added_on_tap), all describing the permanent; there is no key reading the mana produced, so tapped_permanent {} would add {C} for every Forest tapped for {G}. double_nonland_mana / double_land_mana double whatever was made and are split by land/nonland, not by mana type

needs.what: a 'colorless' filter key (zero colours, 105.2c) usable in a static's affects ("Colorless creatures you control get +2/+2") and in a spell_cast trigger filter ("Whenever you cast a colorless spell")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_filter_keys and trigger_filter_keys carry only colors (match any listed colour) and min_colors; colorless is not a colour letter, an empty colors list matches everything, and not_colors exists only in the effect selector language, not in static or trigger filters
